blocks.x: Ready for a night of legendary music, iconic dance moves and pure pop spectacle? MJ the Musical brings the artistry of Michael Jackson to the Broadway stage, making it a must-see for longtime fans and anyone looking for an unforgettable night out in New York City.
The Tony-winning ‘MJ the Musical’ is bringing a Thriller of a night to Broadway this month

Courtesy of MJ the Musical | Photo by Matt Murphy
A four-time Tony Award-winning production, the show centers on the creation of Jackson’s 1992 Dangerous World Tour, giving you an inside glimpse into the creative process behind some of his most celebrated performances. Created by Tony Award-winning director and choreographer Christopher Wheeldon (An American in Paris, The Winter’s Tale, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland) and Pulitzer Prize-winning playwright Lynn Nottage (Ruined, Sweat, Clyde’s), the musical combines a compelling story with dazzling choreography and more than 25 of Jackson’s biggest hits.

Courtesy of MJ the Musical | Photo by Daniel Boud
From “Billie Jean” and “Beat It” to “Thriller,” the production features beloved hits and signature dance moves, offering a closer look at the artistry behind the music. The result feels unmistakably MJ, from the energy of the music to the iconic choreography. And you don’t need to be a regular theatergoer to enjoy it either! If you grew up listening to MJ or recently discovered his music through the biopic, seeing these performances live brings a whole new way to appreciate his influence.

Fishwish58, CC BY-SA 4.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
The show takes place at the historic Neil Simon Theatre, which first opened back in 1927 as the Alvin Theatre. Now, nearly a century later, the landmark Broadway venue is home to the show-stopping MJ the Musical, making it the perfect place to see this production celebrating one of music’s most iconic performers in history.

Courtesy of MJ the Musical | Photo by Daniel Boud
The Midtown Manhattan location makes it easy to grab drinks before or after the performance, so whether you’re planning a fall date night or simply want to experience the King of Pop’s music in a new way, MJ the Musical delivers a Thriller night on Broadway just in time for spooky season.
MJ the Musical has received 5-star reviews from audiences. Here’s what people are saying about the show!

Courtesy of MJ the Musical | Photo by Daniel Boud
“From the very first moments of the show…you are captivated by the incredible talent. The performers, the band, the constant stage scene changes. Wardrobe wonderland. Also, the theater team was fantastic in getting you to your seats and answering any questions. Truly amazing.”
“This show maintains an incredible amount of energy, music & dancing in a great portrayal of Michael Jackson’s life and music career. “
“Great cast! Great music and singing and the main actors are absolutely amazing and look like the real Micheal is performing! A must for musical and Michael fans!”

“This was my third time seeing MJ, but the only time I’ve seen it on Broadway. Every performance has been outstanding: the music, choreography, acting and talent in every show have been unbelievable. I highly recommend it, but be warned: once will not be sufficient.”
Location: Neil Simon Theatre, New York City
Duration: Approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes, including intermission
Who’s ready to celebrate the King of Pop?
